answer_1.quote: We formalize our prompting setup as generating the output ŷl conditioned upon the question and option, i.e., ŷl = argmax P (y|q l ⊕ o l ).
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are answers to multiple-choice questions in various languages, assessed for correctness against ground-truth answers.

answer_2.quote: We compute the cosine similarity between the English queries and their translations. We use multilingual sentence transformers to extract embeddings, which are then used to compute cosine similarity. Our dataset has an average similarity score of 0.89... We observed an average BLEU score of 54.74 which indicates that the translations preserve the concepts of the original queries.

answer_4.quote: 1, 000 queries (same as in back-translation) from each language in XNationQA, i.e., 6, 000 queries in total, were evaluated by language experts. The experts assigned a score of 1 to 5 based on grammar, fluency, and coherence to assess the quality of the dataset.
answer_4.guideline: The experts assigned a score of 1 to 5 based on grammar, fluency, and coherence to assess the quality of the dataset.
